title: Resend – Email API for Developers
description: Resend's live website is a beautifully crafted dark-themed landing page for an email API platform. The design uses a deep charcoal background with vibrant pink and purple gradient accents that create an energetic, modern feel. The hero section features a massive bold headline with gradient text effect, a concise subheading, and a clean CTA button with a secondary ghost button. A live code snippet appears below the fold, showing real API usage — a smart trust-building element for developer audiences. The page employs subtle micro-animations: geometric shapes drift slowly in the background, buttons have smooth hover transitions, and cards lift on interaction. Feature sections use a clean 3-column card grid, each card containing an icon, title, and description with consistent spacing. Stats counters (emails sent, companies trusted) appear with animated number transitions. Customer logos appear in a continuous scrolling marquee. The navigation is a clean top bar with dropdown menus that use glassmorphism effects. The color palette combines deep slate with vibrant magenta and purple accents. Typography uses Inter throughout with extreme weight contrasts — ultralight body text against bold 800-weight headlines.
primary_use_case: Ideal for API-first products and developer tools needing a landing page that balances technical credibility with modern, energetic visual design.
style_vibe: Dark, vibrant, and developer-centric — a modern API product aesthetic that combines code credibility with energetic gradient design.
